hypothesis: ProtoMotions observes one coherent rigid-body state, but UE mixes bone-origin positions with physics-body rotations and velocities. Using each Physics BodyInstance world transform for observation position will improve policy response and reduce recovery AUC.

authoritative_evidence.ue_current_mismatch: BoneWorldTransform.GetLocation() is combined with BodyInstance transform rotation and physics velocities.

single_changed_variable: Observation Position source: skeletal bone world origin versus FBodyInstance world transform origin. Rotation and velocity sources, action conditioning, mask, mapping, control plant, timing, perturbation, and evaluator remain unchanged.

locked_configuration.action_axis: mesh-component parent-bind axis from first policy

validity_gates: Control and experimental use the same binary and differ only by the observation-position source flag.
A trace records bone-to-body position deltas and the selected source for all 24 observation bodies.
Raw ONNX output remains unmodified and target readback is 1.0.
ZeroActions remains exactly zero and physically valid.
support: Experimental Normal passes every absolute criterion and recovery AUC is <= 32.913436978267704.
partial_support: Experimental AUC materially improves but misses threshold; use per-body delta evidence to determine whether root-only or all-body provenance is appropriate.
falsification: Body positions do not improve AUC, lose standing, or make the observation contract less coherent.
next: If supported, test all actions and then run the full product bundle. If partial, split root position provenance from non-root body positions without changing velocity or rotation.
